derivation: Crucibles are built in the world (iron) or upgraded in place; the Enderite crucible (age-of-game tier 5, rows moved from SimpleBuilding with split stage 5; the Enderite barrel went to Simple Storage with WH26-6) is the only one a wandering trader may carry; the copper bucket (row moved from SimpleBuilding with split stage 5b) keeps its price, filled buckets are never traded; the Enderite bucket went to Simple Tools with WH26-7.

excluded.simplecrucibles:crucible_blank: Exists only half-built in the world; no item.
excluded.simplecrucibles:soul_lava_bucket: Soul lava is a world-generation rarity (0.5 % springs, 10 % fortress wells); no trade.
excluded.simplecrucibles:copper_water_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:copper_lava_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
